controls: The AI assistant must generate draft recommended sanctions only as a proposal for HR managers to review and approve. Final decisions remain with the HR manager (Aurora Institute AI Use Policy, Principles).
All access to restricted disciplinary files must be logged and audited, with access restricted to authorized HR managers only (Data Classification and Handling Guide, Levels).
The AI assistant must not generate or recommend sanctions without explicit approval from the HR manager, ensuring accountability for outputs (Aurora Institute AI Use Policy, Principles).

The use case requires approval from the Digital Governance Board due to the handling of restricted information and potential impact on individual staff (AI Use Case Intake Procedure, Risk levels and approval).
The assistant must not fabricate or alter data in disciplinary files, and all outputs must be traceable to the original source (Aurora Institute AI Use Policy, Prohibited uses).
Integration with HR systems must ensure data protection compliance, including encryption and role-based access controls for restricted data (Data Classification and Handling Guide, Levels).
